items.html: And it is similar to what is said in the secret of the Shema, in the word “One,” for then the makifim of Yenika enter together with the Mochin of the VAK of Gadlut — the one that rose in the Yesod as mayim nukvin, to be impregnated in the aspect of the second Ibur, after he already had inner Mochin of Yenika. And it is found that the makifim of Yenika and the inner [Mochin] of the VAK of Gadlut enter together, one after the other, over the course of the seven years that follow the two years of the Yenika; and then he is completed to nine years.
